instruction: Look at hard-17_seed.dxf. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'rack gear mounting strip with tooth layout' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, TOOTH. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Use AutoCAD rectangular ARRAY commands for the repeated tooth modules and hole centers described below, then explode or otherwise convert the arrays before export so the final DXF contains direct LINE/LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, and TEXT/MTEXT entities. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(360,0); OUTLINE (360,0)->(360,45); OUTLINE (360,45)->(0,45); OUTLINE (0,45)->(0,0); TOOTH lead-in (20,45)->(27.5,65); TOOTH lead-in (27.5,65)->(35,45); TOOTH array from two sample lines (35,45)->(47.5,65) and (47.5,65)->(55,45) with 15 columns, column spacing 20, row count 1, yielding repeated tooth modules from x=35 through x=335; CUTOUT (68,27.5)->(112,27.5); CUTOUT (68,17.5)->(112,17.5); CUTOUT (248,27.5)->(292,27.5); CUTOUT (248,17.5)->(292,17.5); CENTER (0,22.5)->(360,22.5); CENTER (20,45)->(340,45). Required circles: HOLE array from sample center (35,22.5) radius 4.5 with 7 columns, column spacing 50, row count 1, yielding x=35,85,135,185,235,285,335 at y=22.5. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (68,22.5) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (112,22.5) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (248,22.5) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (292,22.5) radius 5 start 270 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H17; ANNOTATION text RACK STRIP 16T. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
